verses.1:5: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.1:6: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.
verses.1:7: And the sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshishah, Kittim, and Rodanim.
verses.1:8: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.1:9: And the sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, and Sabteca; and the sons of Raama: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.1:10: And Cush fathered Nimrod; he began to be a mighty man on the earth.
verses.1:17: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.
verses.1:28: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
verses.1:29: These are their generations: Ishmael's firstborn, Nebaioth; and Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,
verses.1:31: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are Ishmael's sons.
verses.1:32: And the sons of Keturah, concubine of Abraham: she gave birth to Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah; and the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
verses.1:33: And the sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these are Keturah's sons.
verses.1:34: Now Abraham fathered Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
verses.1:35: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.1:36: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.
verses.1:37: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.1:38: And the sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.1:39: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and the sister of Lotan was Timna.
verses.1:40: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam; and the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
verses.1:41: The sons of Anah: Dishon; and the sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.1:42: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishon: Uz and Aran.
verses.1:43: And these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before a king reigned over the sons of Israel: Bela son of Beor, and his city's name was Dinhabah.
verses.1:44: Then Bela died, and Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place.
verses.1:45: Then Jobab died, and Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.1:46: Then Husham died, and Hadad son of Bedad, who struck down Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and his city's name was Avith.
verses.1:47: Then Hadad died, and Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.1:48: Then Samlah died, and Shaul from Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
verses.1:49: Then Shaul died, and Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.1:50: Then Baal-hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and his city's name was Pai, and his wife's name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-zahab.
verses.1:51: Then Hadad died. And the chieftains of Edom were: the chieftain of Timna, the chieftain of Alvah, the chieftain of Jetheth,
verses.1:52: the chieftain of Oholibamah, the chieftain of Elah, the chieftain of Pinon,
verses.1:53: the chieftain of Kenaz, the chieftain of Teman, the chieftain of Mibzar,
verses.1:54: the chieftain of Magdiel, the chieftain of Iram. These were the chieftains of Edom.
verses.2:1: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah; Issachar and Zebulun;
verses.2:2: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin; Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.2:3: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah; three were born to him by Bath-shua the Canaanite woman. Now Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the eyes of the LORD, and He put him to death.
verses.2:4: And Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.2:5: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
verses.2:6: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara, five altogether.
verses.2:7: And the sons of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who acted unfaithfully with what was devoted to destruction.
verses.2:8: And the sons of Ethan: Azariah.
verses.2:9: Now the sons of Hezron who were born to him were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.2:10: Ram fathered Amminadab, and Amminadab fathered Nahshon, chief of the sons of Judah.
verses.2:11: Nahshon fathered Salma, and Salma fathered Boaz.
verses.2:12: Boaz fathered Obed, and Obed fathered Jesse.
verses.2:13: Jesse fathered his firstborn, Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,
verses.2:14: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.2:15: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh.
verses.2:16: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three altogether.
verses.2:17: And Abigail bore Amasa, and Amasa's father was Jether the Ishmaelite.
verses.2:18: Now Caleb, the son of Hezron, fathered children with his wife Azubah and with Jerioth; these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.2:19: Azubah died, and Caleb took Ephrath for himself, and she bore him Hur.
verses.2:20: Hur fathered Uri, and Uri fathered Bezalel.
verses.2:21: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir, father of Gilead—he had married her when he was sixty years old—and she bore him Segub.
verses.2:22: Segub fathered Jair, and he had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.2:23: But Geshur and Aram took Havvoth-jair from them, along with Kenath and its villages—sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir, father of Gilead.
verses.2:24: After Hezron's death in Caleb-ephrathah, Hezron's wife Abijah bore him Ashhur, father of Tekoa.
verses.2:25: Now the sons of Jerahmeel, Hezron's firstborn, were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.2:26: And Jerahmeel had another wife, and her name was Atarah; she was Onam's mother.
verses.2:27: And the sons of Ram, Jerahmeel's firstborn, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
verses.2:28: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada; and the sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.
verses.2:29: And the name of Abishur's wife was Abihail; she bore him Ahban and Molid.
verses.2:30: And the sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim; Seled died without sons.
verses.2:31: The sons of Appaim: Ishi; the sons of Ishi: Sheshan; and the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
verses.2:32: And the sons of Jada, Shammai's brother, were Jether and Jonathan; Jether died without sons.
verses.2:33: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.2:34: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters; and Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, and his name was Jarha.
verses.2:35: So Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as a wife, and she bore him Attai.
verses.2:36: Attai fathered Nathan, and Nathan fathered Zabad.
verses.2:37: Zabad fathered Ephlal, and Ephlal fathered Obed.
verses.2:38: Obed fathered Jehu, and Jehu fathered Azariah.
verses.2:39: Azariah fathered Helez, and Helez fathered Eleasah.
verses.2:40: Eleasah fathered Sismai, and Sismai fathered Shallum.
verses.2:41: Shallum fathered Jekamiah, and Jekamiah fathered Elishama.
verses.2:42: Now the sons of Caleb, Jerahmeel's brother, were Mesha his firstborn—he was the father of Ziph—and the sons of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.
verses.2:43: And the sons of Hebron were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.
verses.2:44: Shema fathered Raham, father of Jorkeam, and Rekem fathered Shammai.
verses.2:45: And Shammai's son was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.2:46: And Ephah, the concubine of Caleb, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran fathered Gazez.
verses.2:47: And the sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.2:48: Caleb's concubine Maacah bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
verses.2:49: And she bore Shaaph, father of Madmannah, and Sheva, father of Machbenah and father of Gibea; and Caleb's daughter was Achsah.
verses.2:50: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim,
verses.2:51: Salma, the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph, the father of Beth-gader.
verses.2:52: And Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
verses.2:53: The clans of Kiriath-jearim were the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from these came forth the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
verses.2:54: The sons of Salma were Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
verses.2:55: And the clans of scribes living at Jabez were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. They are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.3:1: And these were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn was Amnon, by Ahinoam the Jezreelite; the second, Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite;
verses.3:2: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;
verses.3:3: the fifth, Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth, Ithream, by Eglah his wife.
verses.3:4: Six were born to him in Hebron, and he reigned there seven years and six months; and he reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
verses.3:5: And these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four by Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel;
verses.3:9: All these were the sons of David, apart from the sons of concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
verses.3:10: Now the son of Solomon was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.3:11: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.3:12: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.3:13: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.3:14: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.3:15: And the sons of Josiah: the firstborn was Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.3:16: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.3:17: And the sons of Jeconiah the captive: Shealtiel his son,
verses.3:18: and Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.3:19: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. And the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah, and Shelomith was their sister;
verses.3:20: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed—five.
verses.3:21: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
verses.3:22: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. And the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat—six.
verses.3:23: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam—three.
verses.3:24: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani—seven.
verses.4:1: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.
verses.4:2: And Reaiah the son of Shobal fathered Jahath, and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These were the clans of the Zorathites.
verses.4:3: And these were of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.
verses.4:4: And Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.
verses.4:5: And Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives: Helah and Naarah.
verses.4:6: And Naarah bore to him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.4:7: And the sons of Helah: Zereth, Zohar, and Ethnan.
verses.4:8: And Koz fathered Anub and Zobebah, and the clans of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.4:9: And Jabez was more honored than his brothers, and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, "Because I gave birth in pain."
verses.4:10: And Jabez called out to the God of Israel, saying, "If only You would indeed bless me and increase my territory, and Your hand would be with me, and You would preserve me from harm so that it causes me no pain!" And God brought about what he asked.
verses.4:11: And Chelub, the brother of Shuhah, fathered Mehir; he was the father of Eshton.
verses.4:12: And Eshton fathered Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. These were the men of Recah.
verses.4:13: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. And the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
verses.4:14: And Meonothai fathered Ophrah. And Seraiah fathered Joab, the father of the Valley of Craftsmen, for they were craftsmen.
verses.4:15: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. And the sons of Elah: Kenaz.
verses.4:16: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
verses.4:17: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon. And she conceived Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.4:18: And his Judean wife bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these were the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered married.
verses.4:19: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham: the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
verses.4:20: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.
verses.4:21: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the clans of the house of fine linen workers at Beth-ashbea;
verses.4:22: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who ruled over Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these accounts are ancient.
verses.4:23: These were the potters and those who lived in Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king in his work.
verses.4:24: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul;
verses.4:25: Shallum was his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.4:26: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.4:27: Now Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many sons, and their entire clan did not multiply as much as the sons of Judah.
verses.4:28: And they lived in Beersheba, Moladah, Hazar-shual,
verses.4:31: in Beth-marcaboth, Hazar-susim, Beth-biri, and Shaaraim. These were their cities until David reigned.
verses.4:32: And their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities,
verses.4:33: and all their villages that were around these cities as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they had their own genealogical record.
verses.4:34: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.4:35: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.4:36: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,
verses.4:37: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah.
verses.4:38: These who are listed by name were leaders in their clans, and their fathers' houses expanded greatly.
verses.4:39: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.4:40: And they found rich and good pasture, and the land was wide-open, tranquil, and peaceful; for those who had lived there formerly were from Ham.
verses.4:41: And these who were recorded by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunites who were found there, and devoted them to destruction to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture for their flocks there.
verses.4:42: And some of them, from the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, with Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, at their head.
verses.4:43: And they struck down the remnant of the survivors of Amalek, and they have lived there to this day.
verses.5:1: Now the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel—for he was the firstborn, yet when he profaned his father's bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel, though registration by genealogy was not according to the birthright.
verses.5:2: For Judah prevailed among his brothers, and a ruler came from him, while the birthright was Joseph's.
verses.5:3: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.
verses.5:4: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.5:5: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
verses.5:6: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried into exile; he was chief of the Reubenites.
verses.5:7: And his kinsmen by his clans, when registered by genealogy according to their generations: the head, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.5:8: and Bela, son of Azaz, son of Shema, son of Joel; he lived in Aroer and as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.
verses.5:9: And toward the east he lived as far as the entrance to the wilderness from the Euphrates River, for their livestock had grown numerous in the land of Gilead.
verses.5:10: And in the days of Saul they waged war against the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents across the entire territory east of Gilead.
verses.5:11: And opposite them, the sons of Gad lived in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah.
verses.5:12: Joel was the head, and Shapham the second, and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.5:13: And their kinsmen according to their fathers' houses were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber—seven.
verses.5:14: These were the sons of Abihail, son of Huri, son of Jaroah, son of Gilead, son of Michael, son of Jeshishai, son of Jahdo, son of Buz.
verses.5:15: Ahi, son of Abdiel, son of Guni, was head of their fathers' house.
verses.5:16: And they lived in Gilead, in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasturelands of Sharon as far as their outer limits.
verses.5:17: All of them were registered by genealogy in the days of Jotham king of Judah and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.5:18: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh had men of valor—men bearing shield and sword, bending the bow, and trained for war—forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty going out to military service.
verses.5:19: And they waged war against the Hagrites, Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
verses.5:20: And they were helped against them, and the Hagrites and all who were with them were given into their hand; for they cried out to God in the battle, and He responded favorably to them because they trusted in Him.
verses.5:21: And they captured their livestock: fifty thousand of their camels, two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, two thousand donkeys, and one hundred thousand people.
verses.5:22: For many fell struck down, because the war was from God, and they lived in place of them until the exile.
verses.5:23: And the sons of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land from Bashan as far as Baal-hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon; they were numerous.
verses.5:24: And these were the heads of their fathers' houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, men of renown, heads of their fathers' houses.
verses.5:25: But they acted unfaithfully against the God of their fathers, and prostituted themselves after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God had destroyed from before them.
verses.5:26: So the God of Israel roused the spirit of Pul king of Assyria and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh into exile, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and the river of Gozan, to this day.
verses.5:27: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.5:28: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.5:29: And the children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
verses.5:30: Eleazar fathered Phinehas; Phinehas fathered Abishua.
verses.5:31: And Abishua fathered Bukki, and Bukki fathered Uzzi.
verses.5:32: And Uzzi fathered Zerahiah, and Zerahiah fathered Meraioth.
verses.5:33: Meraioth fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub.
verses.5:34: And Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Ahimaaz.
verses.5:35: And Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, and Azariah fathered Johanan.
verses.5:36: And Johanan fathered Azariah—he was the one who ministered as priest in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
verses.5:37: And Azariah fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub.
verses.5:38: And Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Shallum.
verses.5:39: And Shallum fathered Hilkiah, and Hilkiah fathered Azariah.
verses.5:40: And Azariah fathered Seraiah, and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak.
verses.5:41: And Jehozadak went away when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem into exile by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.6:1: Levi's sons were Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.6:2: And these are the names of Gershom's sons: Libni and Shimei.
verses.6:3: And Kohath's sons were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.6:4: Merari's sons were Mahli and Mushi. And these are the clans of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.6:5: Belonging to Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.6:6: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
verses.6:7: Kohath's sons: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.6:8: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.6:9: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.6:10: And Elkanah's sons were Amasai and Ahimoth.
verses.6:11: Elkanah: Elkanah's sons were Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.6:12: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.6:13: And Samuel's sons were the firstborn Vashni, and Abijah.
verses.6:14: Merari's sons: Mahli; Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
verses.6:15: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.6:16: And these are the ones whom David stationed over the direction of song in the house of the LORD after the ark came to rest.
verses.6:17: And they were ministering before the tabernacle of the tent of meeting with song until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem, and they stood at their service according to their prescribed order.
verses.6:18: And these are the ones who stood, and their sons: from the sons of the Kohathites, Heman the singer, son of Joel, son of Samuel,
verses.6:19: son of Elkanah, son of Jeroham, son of Eliel, son of Toah,
verses.6:20: son of Zuph, son of Elkanah, son of Mahath, son of Amasai,
verses.6:21: son of Elkanah, son of Joel, son of Azariah, son of Zephaniah,
verses.6:22: son of Tahath, son of Assir, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah,
verses.6:23: son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, son of Israel.
verses.6:24: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right: Asaph son of Berechiah, son of Shimea,
verses.6:25: son of Michael, son of Baaseiah, son of Malchijah,
verses.6:26: son of Ethni, son of Zerah, son of Adaiah,
verses.6:27: son of Ethan, son of Zimmah, son of Shimei,
verses.6:28: son of Jahath, son of Gershom, son of Levi.
verses.6:29: And the sons of Merari, their brothers, were on the left: Ethan son of Kishi, son of Abdi, son of Malluch,
verses.6:30: son of Hashabiah, son of Amaziah, son of Hilkiah,
verses.6:31: son of Amzi, son of Bani, son of Shemer,
verses.6:32: son of Mahli, son of Mushi, son of Merari, son of Levi.
verses.6:33: And their brothers the Levites were given for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.6:34: But Aaron and his sons burned offerings on the altar of burnt offering and on the altar of incense for all the work of the Most Holy Place, and to make atonement for Israel, in accordance with everything that Moses the servant of God commanded.
verses.6:35: And these are Aaron's sons: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.6:36: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.6:37: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.6:38: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.6:39: And these are their dwelling places according to their encampments within their territory, for the sons of Aaron of the clan of the Kohathites, because the lot fell to them.
verses.6:40: So they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah and its pasturelands surrounding it.
verses.6:41: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb son of Jephunneh.
verses.6:42: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge: Hebron, Libnah and its pasturelands, Jattir, Eshtemoa and its pasturelands,
verses.6:43: Hilez and its pasturelands, Debir and its pasturelands,
verses.6:44: Ashan and its pasturelands, and Beth-shemesh and its pasturelands;
verses.6:45: and from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba and its pasturelands, Alemeth and its pasturelands, and Anathoth and its pasturelands. All their cities throughout their clans were thirteen cities.
verses.6:46: And to the remaining sons of Kohath were given ten cities by lot from the clan of the tribe, from the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh.
verses.6:47: And to the sons of Gershom, according to their clans, were given thirteen cities from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
verses.6:48: To the sons of Merari, according to their clans, were given twelve cities by lot from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun.
verses.6:49: Thus the sons of Israel gave the cities and their pasturelands to the Levites.
verses.6:50: And they gave by lot from the tribe of the sons of Judah, from the tribe of the sons of Simeon, and from the tribe of the sons of Benjamin these cities that are called by name.
verses.6:51: And for some of the clans of the sons of Kohath, the cities of their territory were from the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.6:52: And they gave them the cities of refuge: Shechem and its pasturelands in the hill country of Ephraim, Gezer and its pasturelands,
verses.6:53: Jokmeam and its pasturelands, Beth-horon and its pasturelands,
verses.6:54: Aijalon and its pasturelands, and Gath-rimmon and its pasturelands;
verses.6:55: and from the half-tribe of Manasseh: Aner and its pasturelands, and Bileam and its pasturelands, for the clan of the remaining sons of Kohath.
verses.6:56: To the sons of Gershom were given from the clan of the half-tribe of Manasseh: Golan in Bashan and its pasturelands, and Ashtaroth and its pasturelands;
verses.6:57: and from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh and its pasturelands, Daberath and its pasturelands,
verses.6:58: Ramoth and its pasturelands, and Anem and its pasturelands;
verses.6:59: and from the tribe of Asher: Mashal and its pasturelands, Abdon and its pasturelands,
verses.6:60: Hukok and its pasturelands, and Rehob and its pasturelands;
verses.6:61: and from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee and its pasturelands, Hammon and its pasturelands, and Kiriathaim and its pasturelands.
verses.6:62: To the remaining sons of Merari were given from the tribe of Zebulun: Rimmono and its pasturelands, and Tabor and its pasturelands;
verses.6:63: and across the Jordan at Jericho, to the east of the Jordan, from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness and its pasturelands, Jahzah and its pasturelands,
verses.6:64: Kedemoth and its pasturelands, and Mephaath and its pasturelands;
verses.6:65: and from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead and its pasturelands, Mahanaim and its pasturelands,
verses.6:66: Heshbon and its pasturelands, and Jazer and its pasturelands.
verses.7:1: Now as for the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.7:2: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Samuel, heads of their fathers' houses, of Tola, valiant warriors by their generations; their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.
verses.7:3: And the sons of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them were heads.
verses.7:4: And along with them, by their generations, according to their fathers' houses, were troops of an army for war, thirty-six thousand, because they had numerous wives and sons.
verses.7:5: And their relatives across all the clans of Issachar were valiant warriors, eighty-seven thousand by their genealogical enrollment in total.
verses.7:6: Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.7:7: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five, heads of fathers' houses, valiant warriors; and their genealogical enrollment was twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
verses.7:8: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All of these were sons of Becher.
verses.7:9: And their genealogical enrollment by their generations, heads of their fathers' houses, valiant warriors, was twenty thousand two hundred.
verses.7:10: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.7:11: All of these were sons of Jediael, according to the ancestral heads, valiant warriors, seventeen thousand two hundred going out in the army for war.
verses.7:12: And Shuppim and Huppim were sons of Ir; Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.7:13: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, sons of Bilhah.
verses.7:14: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom she bore; his Aramean concubine bore Machir, the father of Gilead.
verses.7:15: And Machir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim, and his sister's name was Maacah; and the second one's name was Zelophehad, and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.7:16: And Maacah, Machir's wife, bore a son, and she called his name Peresh; his brother's name was Sheresh, and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.7:17: And the sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh.
verses.7:18: And his sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
verses.7:19: Now the sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.7:20: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
verses.7:21: and Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead. And the men of Gath born in the land killed them, for they had gone down to take their livestock.
verses.7:22: And Ephraim their father mourned for many days, and his brothers came to console him.
verses.7:23: And he went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son; and he called his name Beriah, for calamity was in his house.
verses.7:24: And his daughter was Sheerah, and she built Beth-horon the Lower and the Upper, and Uzzen-sheerah.
verses.7:25: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.7:26: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.7:27: Non his son, Joshua his son.
verses.7:28: And their possession and their dwelling places were Bethel and its villages, and toward the east Naaran, and toward the west Gezer and its villages, and Shechem and its villages as far as Ayyah and its villages;
verses.7:29: and alongside the sons of Manasseh were Beth-shean and its villages, Taanach and its villages, Megiddo and its villages, and Dor and its villages. In these the sons of Joseph, son of Israel, lived.
verses.7:30: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah, and their sister Serah.
verses.7:31: And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel; he was the father of Birzaith.
verses.7:32: And Heber fathered Japhlet, Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.7:33: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These were sons of Japhlet.
verses.7:34: And the sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
verses.7:35: And the sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.7:36: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
verses.7:37: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
verses.7:38: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara.
verses.7:39: And the sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
verses.7:40: All of these were sons of Asher, heads of the fathers' houses, chosen, valiant warriors, heads of the leaders; and as for their genealogical enrollment in the army for war, their number was twenty-six thousand men.
verses.8:1: Now Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.8:2: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.8:3: And Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, and Abihud;
verses.8:6: Now these are the sons of Ehud—these were heads of paternal houses for the inhabitants of Geba, and they exiled them to Manahath—
verses.8:7: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera; it was he who exiled them, and he fathered Uzza and Ahihud.
verses.8:8: And Shaharaim fathered children in the territory of Moab after he had sent them away—Hushim and Baara, his wives.
verses.8:9: And by his wife Hodesh he fathered Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,
verses.8:10: Jeuz, Sachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of paternal houses.
verses.8:11: And by Hushim he fathered Abitub and Elpaal.
verses.8:12: Now the sons of Elpaal were Eber, Misham, and Shemed—it was he who built Ono and Lod and its villages—
verses.8:13: and Beriah and Shema—they were the heads of the paternal houses of the inhabitants of Aijalon; it was they who made the inhabitants of Gath flee—
verses.8:16: Michael, Ishpah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.
verses.8:18: Ishmerai, Izliah, and Jobab were the sons of Elpaal.
verses.8:21: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimei.
verses.8:25: Iphdeiah, and Penuel were the sons of Shashak.
verses.8:27: Jaareshiah, Elijah, and Zichri were the sons of Jeroham.
verses.8:28: These were heads of paternal houses by their generations, leaders; these lived in Jerusalem.
verses.8:29: And in Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, and the name of his wife was Maacah.
verses.8:30: And his firstborn son was Abdon; also Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,
verses.8:32: And Mikloth fathered Shimeah. And they too lived opposite their relatives in Jerusalem, with their relatives.
verses.8:33: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.8:34: Now Jonathan's son was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal fathered Micah.
verses.8:35: And Micah's sons were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.8:36: And Ahaz fathered Jehoaddah, and Jehoaddah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri, and Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.8:37: And Moza fathered Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah was his son, and Azel was his son.
verses.8:38: Now Azel had six sons; these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All of these were Azel's sons.
verses.8:39: And the sons of his brother Eshek were Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.8:40: And the sons of Ulam were men mighty in valor, who bent the bow and had many sons and grandsons, one hundred and fifty. All of these were from the sons of Benjamin.
verses.9:1: Now all Israel was registered by genealogy, and look, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel; and Judah was exiled to Babylon because of their unfaithfulness.
verses.9:2: And the first inhabitants who were in their possession in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.
verses.9:3: And in Jerusalem lived some of the sons of Judah, some of the sons of Benjamin, and some of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:
verses.9:4: Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani, from the sons of Perez son of Judah.
verses.9:5: And from the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.
verses.9:6: And from the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.
verses.9:7: And from the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Hassenuah;
verses.9:8: and Ibneiah son of Jeroham, and Elah son of Uzzi, son of Michri, and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah.
verses.9:9: And their brothers, according to their generations, were nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers' houses for their fathers' households.
verses.9:10: And from the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin;
verses.9:11: and Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.9:12: and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemith, son of Immer;
verses.9:13: and their brothers, heads of their fathers' houses, one thousand seven hundred and sixty, mighty men of ability for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.9:14: And from the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, from the sons of Merari;
verses.9:15: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah son of Mica, son of Zichri, son of Asaph;
verses.9:16: and Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.9:17: Now the gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, and Ahiman; and their brother Shallum was the chief.
verses.9:18: And until now, at the king's gate on the east, they were the gatekeepers for the camps of the sons of Levi.
verses.9:19: Now Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his brothers of his father's house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent; and their fathers had been over the camp of the LORD, keepers of the entrance.
verses.9:20: And Phinehas son of Eleazar was ruler over them in former times; the LORD was with him.
verses.9:21: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper at the doorway of the tent of meeting.
verses.9:22: All those selected as gatekeepers at the thresholds numbered two hundred and twelve. They were registered by genealogy in their villages; David and Samuel the seer established them in their position of trust.
verses.9:23: And they and their sons were over the gates of the house of the LORD, the house of the tent, by watches.
verses.9:24: The gatekeepers were on the four sides: east, west, north, and south.
verses.9:25: And their brothers in their villages were to come in every seven days, from time to time, to be with these;
verses.9:26: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in a position of trust, and they were over the chambers and over the treasuries of the house of God.
verses.9:27: And they spent the night around the house of God, because the guard duty was upon them, and they were in charge of the key, morning by morning.
verses.9:28: And some of them were over the vessels of the service, for they brought them in by count and took them out by count.
verses.9:29: And others of them were appointed over the vessels and over all the holy vessels, and over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.9:30: And some of the sons of the priests compounded the mixture of the spices.
verses.9:31: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was in a position of trust over the making of the griddle cakes.
verses.9:32: And some of the sons of the Kohathites, from among their brothers, were over the rows of bread, to prepare it Sabbath by Sabbath.
verses.9:33: Now these were the singers, heads of fathers' houses of the Levites, who were in the chambers, exempt from other duties, because day and night they were on duty in the work.
verses.9:34: These were the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites according to their generations, chief men; these lived in Jerusalem.
verses.9:35: And in Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and the name of his wife was Maacah.
verses.9:36: And his firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,
verses.9:38: And Mikloth fathered Shimeam. And they also lived opposite their brothers in Jerusalem, with their brothers.
verses.9:39: And Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
verses.9:40: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal, and Meri-baal fathered Micah.
verses.9:41: And the sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, and Tahrea.
verses.9:42: And Ahaz fathered Jarah, and Jarah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.
verses.9:43: And Moza fathered Binea, and Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.9:44: And Azel had six sons, and these are their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
verses.10:1: Now the Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel fled before the Philistines and fell dead on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:2: And the Philistines pressed hard after Saul and after his sons, and the Philistines struck down Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.10:3: And the battle grew heavy against Saul, and those shooting with the bow found him, and he writhed in pain from the archers.
verses.10:4: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and pierce me through with it, or else these uncircumcised men will come and treat me cruelly." But his armor-bearer was unwilling, because he was deeply afraid. So Saul took the sword and fell upon it.
verses.10:5: When his armor-bearer saw that Saul was dead, he too fell upon the sword and died.
verses.10:6: So Saul and his three sons died, and all his household died together.
verses.10:7: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they had fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled; and the Philistines came and settled in them.
verses.10:8: Now on the next day, the Philistines came to strip the dead, and they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
verses.10:9: And they stripped him and took his head and his armor, and sent word all around the land of the Philistines to proclaim the good news to their idols and to the people.
verses.10:10: And they placed his armor in the house of their gods, and they fastened his skull in the house of Dagon.
verses.10:11: And all Jabesh-gilead heard everything that the Philistines had done to Saul.
verses.10:12: So all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons and brought them to Jabesh. And they buried their bones under the terebinth in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.10:13: So Saul died for his unfaithfulness, in that he acted unfaithfully against the LORD concerning the word of the LORD which he did not keep, and also for consulting a medium to make inquiry,
verses.10:14: and he did not inquire of the LORD. So He put him to death and turned the kingship to David son of Jesse.
verses.11:1: Then all Israel assembled to David at Hebron, saying, "Look, we are your bone and your flesh.
verses.11:2: Even in former times, even while Saul was king, you were the one leading Israel out and bringing them in. And the LORD your God said to you, 'You will shepherd My people Israel, and you will be ruler over My people Israel.'"
verses.11:3: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. Then they anointed David as king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Samuel.
verses.11:4: Then David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus, and there were the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.11:5: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, "You will not come here." But David seized the stronghold of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.11:6: And David said, "Whoever strikes down a Jebusite first will be chief and commander." Joab son of Zeruiah went up first, and he became chief.
verses.11:7: And David lived in the stronghold; therefore they named it the city of David.
verses.11:8: And he built the city all around, from the Millo to the surrounding circuit, while Joab restored the remainder of the city.
verses.11:9: And David grew steadily greater, and the LORD of hosts was with him.
verses.11:10: Now these are the chiefs of the mighty warriors who belonged to David, who stood strong with him in his kingdom, along with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel.
verses.11:11: And this is the number of the mighty warriors who belonged to David: Jashobeam son of Hachmoni, chief of the captains; he raised his spear against three hundred and killed them on a single occasion.
verses.11:12: After him was Eleazar son of Dodo the Ahohite; he was among the three mighty warriors.
verses.11:13: He was with David at Pas-dammim when the Philistines had assembled there for battle, and a plot of the field was full of barley, and the people fled from the Philistines.
verses.11:14: Yet they took their stand in the middle of the plot, rescued it, and struck down the Philistines; and the LORD brought about a great deliverance.
verses.11:15: Then three of the thirty chiefs went down to the rock to David, to the cave of Adullam, while the camp of the Philistines was encamped in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.11:16: David was in the stronghold at that time, and a garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.
verses.11:17: Then David felt a longing and said, "Who will give me water to drink from the cistern of Bethlehem that is by the gate?"
verses.11:18: Then the three broke through the camp of the Philistines, drew water from the cistern of Bethlehem that was by the gate, carried it, and brought it to David. Yet David was unwilling to drink it, and he poured it out to the LORD.
verses.11:19: And he said, "May it be far from me before my God to do this! Should I drink the blood of these men with their lives? For at the risk of their lives they brought it." So he was unwilling to drink it. These things the three mighty warriors did.
verses.11:20: Now Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; and he raised his spear against three hundred and killed them, and he had a name among the three.
verses.11:21: Of the three, he was doubly honored, and he became their commander; yet he did not attain to the three.
verses.11:22: Benaiah son of Jehoiada, son of a valiant man, great in deeds, from Kabzeel—he struck down the two lion-like heroes of Moab, and he went down and struck down a lion inside a pit on a day of snow.
verses.11:23: And he struck down an Egyptian, a man of stature, five cubits tall. In the Egyptian's hand was a spear like a weaver's beam, yet he went down to him with a staff, wrested the spear from the Egyptian's hand, and killed him with his own spear.
verses.11:24: These things Benaiah son of Jehoiada did, and he had a name among the three mighty warriors.
verses.11:25: Indeed, he was honored above the thirty, yet he did not attain to the three; and David placed him over his bodyguard.
verses.11:26: Now the mighty warriors of the armies were Asahel the brother of Joab; Elhanan son of Dodo from Bethlehem;
verses.11:27: Shammoth the Harorite; Helez the Pelonite;
verses.11:28: Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; Abiezer the Anathothite;
verses.11:29: Sibbecai the Hushathite; Ilai the Ahohite;
verses.11:30: Maharai the Netophathite; Heled son of Baanah the Netophathite;
verses.11:31: Ithai son of Ribai from Gibeah of the sons of Benjamin; Benaiah the Pirathonite;
verses.11:32: Hurai from the streams of Gaash; Abiel the Arbathite;
verses.11:33: Azmaveth the Baharumite; Eliahba the Shaalbonite;
verses.11:34: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite; Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite;
verses.11:35: Ahiam son of Sacar the Hararite; Eliphal son of Ur;
verses.11:36: Hepher the Mecherathite; Ahijah the Pelonite;
verses.11:37: Hezro the Carmelite; Naarai son of Ezbai;
verses.11:38: Joel the brother of Nathan; Mibhar son of Hagri;
verses.11:39: Zelek the Ammonite; Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab son of Zeruiah;
verses.11:40: Ira the Ithrite; Gareb the Ithrite;
verses.11:41: Uriah the Hittite; Zabad son of Ahlai;
verses.11:42: Adina son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him;
verses.11:43: Hanan son of Maacah and Joshaphat the Mithnite;
verses.11:44: Uzzia the Ashterathite; Shama and Jeiel, the sons of Hotham the Aroerite;
verses.11:45: Jediael son of Shimri and Joha his brother, the Tizite;
verses.11:46: Eliel the Mahavite; and Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam; and Ithmah the Moabite;
verses.11:47: Eliel, and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
verses.12:1: These are the men who came to David at Ziklag while he was still kept in restraint on account of Saul the son of Kish; they were among the mighty warriors, helpers in the battle.
verses.12:2: They were equipped with the bow, using both the right hand and the left with stones and with arrows from the bow; they were from Saul's kinsmen, of Benjamin.
verses.12:3: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Beracah, and Jehu the Anathothite;
verses.12:4: and Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty warrior among the Thirty and over the Thirty;
verses.12:5: and Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Jozabad the Gederathite.
verses.12:6: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
verses.12:7: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
verses.12:8: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.
verses.12:9: From the Gadites, mighty warriors of valor separated themselves to David at the stronghold in the wilderness, men of the army for battle, wielding shield and spear; their faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as gazelles upon the mountains:
verses.12:10: Ezer was the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.12:11: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.12:12: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.12:13: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.12:14: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
verses.12:15: These from the sons of Gad were chiefs of the army; the least was one to a hundred, and the greatest to a thousand.
verses.12:16: These are the men who crossed the Jordan in the first month, when it was overflowing all its banks, and they forced into flight all those of the valleys, toward the east and toward the west.
verses.12:17: And some from the sons of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.
verses.12:18: David went out to meet them, and he answered and said to them, "If you have come to me in peace to help me, my heart will be united toward you; but if to betray me to my adversaries, though there is no violence in my hands, may the God of our fathers see and pass judgment."
verses.12:19: Then the spirit clothed Amasai, chief of the officers: "We are yours, David, and with you, son of Jesse! Peace, peace to you, and peace to your helper, for your God has helped you!" So David received them and placed them among the chiefs of the troop.
verses.12:20: And some from Manasseh defected to David when he came with the Philistines against Saul for battle, yet they did not help them, for after consultation the lords of the Philistines sent him away, saying, "At the cost of our heads he will defect to his master Saul."
verses.12:21: As he went to Ziklag, there defected to him from Manasseh Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, chiefs of the thousands belonging to Manasseh.
verses.12:22: And they helped David against the raiding band, for all of them were mighty warriors of valor, and they became commanders in the army.
verses.12:23: For day by day men kept coming to David to help him, until there was a great camp, like the camp of God.
verses.12:24: Now these are the numbers of the divisions armed for the army who came to David at Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul over to him, according to the command of the LORD:
verses.12:25: The sons of Judah bearing shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for the army.
verses.12:26: From the sons of Simeon, mighty warriors of valor for the army, seven thousand one hundred.
verses.12:27: From the sons of Levi, four thousand six hundred;
verses.12:28: and Jehoiada, the leader of the Aaronites, and with him three thousand seven hundred,
verses.12:29: and Zadok, a young man, a mighty warrior of valor, with twenty-two commanders from his father's house.
verses.12:30: From the sons of Benjamin, Saul's kinsmen, three thousand, for until that time the majority of them had kept guard for the house of Saul.
verses.12:31: From the sons of Ephraim, twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty warriors of valor, men of renown in their fathers' houses.
verses.12:32: From the half-tribe of Manasseh, eighteen thousand, who were designated by name to come and make David king.
verses.12:33: From the sons of Issachar, men with discernment for the times, knowing what Israel should do; their chiefs were two hundred, and all their kinsmen were at their command.
verses.12:34: From Zebulun, those going out to the army, drawing up for battle with all weapons of war, fifty thousand, to keep rank without a double heart.
verses.12:35: From Naphtali, one thousand commanders, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shield and spear.
verses.12:36: From the Danites, drawing up for battle, twenty-eight thousand six hundred.
verses.12:37: From Asher, those going out to the army to draw up for battle, forty thousand.
verses.12:38: And from beyond the Jordan, from the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all weapons for military warfare, one hundred twenty thousand.
verses.12:39: All these men of war, keeping battle formation, came to Hebron with a whole heart to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel as well were of one heart to make David king.
verses.12:40: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking, for their kinsmen had made preparation for them.
verses.12:41: Moreover, those who were near to them, even as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, were bringing food on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen: provisions of flour, fig cakes, raisin cakes, wine, oil, oxen, and sheep in abundance, for there was joy in Israel.
verses.13:1: Then David took counsel with the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, with every leader.
verses.13:2: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If it seems good to you, and if it is from the LORD our God, let us send word far and wide to our kinsmen who remain in all the lands of Israel, and with them to the priests and the Levites in their cities with pasturelands, so that they may gather to us,
verses.13:3: and let us bring back the ark of our God to ourselves, for we did not inquire of it in the days of Saul."
verses.13:4: Then all the assembly declared that they would do so, for the matter was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.13:5: So David assembled all Israel from the Shihor of Egypt to Lebo-hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
verses.13:6: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim, which belongs to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, the LORD who sits enthroned above the cherubim, which is called by the Name.
verses.13:7: And they mounted the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio were driving the cart.
verses.13:8: And David and all Israel were celebrating before God with all strength, with songs, lyres, harps, tambourines, cymbals, and trumpets.
verses.13:9: When they came to the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza reached out his hand to take hold of the ark, for the oxen stumbled.
verses.13:10: And the anger of the LORD burned against Uzza, and He struck him down because he had reached out his hand to the ark; and he died there before God.
verses.13:11: And David grew angry because the LORD had broken out in an outbreak against Uzza; and he called that place Perez-uzza, as it is to this day.
verses.13:12: And David feared God that day, saying, "How can I bring the ark of God to myself?"
verses.13:13: So David did not move the ark to himself into the city of David, but turned it aside to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.13:14: Thus the ark of God remained with the household of Obed-edom in his house for three months, and the LORD blessed the household of Obed-edom and all that belonged to him.
verses.14:1: Now Huram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, with cedar timbers, masons, and carpenters, to build a house for him.
verses.14:2: And David knew that the LORD had established him as king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted for the sake of His people Israel.
verses.14:3: And David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David fathered more sons and daughters.
verses.14:4: Now these are the names of those born to him in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,
verses.14:8: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to search for David; and David heard of it and went out to face them.
verses.14:9: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the Valley of Rephaim.
verses.14:10: And David inquired of God, saying, "Shall I go up against the Philistines, and will You give them into my hand?" And the LORD said to him, "Go up, and I will give them into your hand."
verses.14:11: So they went up to Baal-perazim, and David struck them down there; and David said, "God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a breakthrough of waters." Therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.14:12: And they abandoned their gods there, and David gave an order, and they were burned with fire.
verses.14:13: And the Philistines once again made a raid in the valley.
verses.14:14: So David inquired again of God, and God said to him, "Do not go up after them; circle around away from them and come upon them opposite the balsam trees.
verses.14:15: And when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees, then go out into battle, for God has gone out before you to strike down the army of the Philistines."
verses.14:16: And David did just as God had commanded him, and they struck down the army of the Philistines from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
verses.14:17: And the renown of David went out into all the lands, and the LORD put the dread of him upon all the nations.
verses.15:1: He built houses for himself in the City of David, prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tent for it.
verses.15:2: Then David said, "No one may carry the ark of God except the Levites, because the LORD chose them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister to Him forever."
verses.15:3: David convened all Israel to Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.15:4: Then David gathered the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.15:5: Of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the leader, and his brothers, one hundred twenty.
verses.15:6: Of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the leader, and his brothers, two hundred twenty.
verses.15:7: Of the sons of Gershom: Joel the leader, and his brothers, one hundred thirty.
verses.15:8: Of the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the leader, and his brothers, two hundred.
verses.15:9: Of the sons of Hebron: Eliel the leader, and his brothers, eighty.
verses.15:10: Of the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the leader, and his brothers, one hundred twelve.
verses.15:11: Then David summoned Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and the Levites: Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
verses.15:12: He said to them, "You are the heads of the fathers' families of the Levites; consecrate yourselves, you and your brothers, and bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
verses.15:13: Because it was not you the first time, the LORD our God broke out against us, since we did not seek Him according to the ordinance."
verses.15:14: Then the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves in order to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
verses.15:15: The sons of the Levites carried the ark of God, just as Moses had commanded according to the word of the LORD, on their shoulders with the poles upon them.
verses.15:16: And David told the leaders of the Levites to appoint their brothers the singers with musical instruments—harps, lyres, and cymbals—sounding aloud to lift up sounds of joy.
verses.15:17: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; from his brothers, Asaph son of Berechiah; and from the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan son of Kushaiah.
verses.15:18: With them were their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.
verses.15:19: The singers Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound aloud with bronze cymbals;
verses.15:20: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play harps according to Alamoth;
verses.15:21: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead with lyres according to the Sheminith.
verses.15:22: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites in music, gave instruction in the music, because he was skilled.
verses.15:23: Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.15:24: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were blowing the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were gatekeepers for the ark.
verses.15:25: So David, together with the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
verses.15:26: Now when God helped the Levites carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.15:27: David was wrapped in a robe of fine linen, along with all the Levites carrying the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah, leader of the music of the singers; and upon David was a linen ephod.
verses.15:28: Thus all Israel was bringing up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, with the sound of the ram's horn, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud on harps and lyres.
verses.15:29: When the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the City of David, Michal daughter of Saul looked down through the window; she saw King David dancing and making merry, and she despised him in her heart.
verses.16:1: They brought the ark of God in and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it, and they presented burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
verses.16:2: David finished offering up the burnt offering and the peace offerings, and he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.
verses.16:3: He distributed to every Israelite, both man and woman, to each person a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a raisin cake.
verses.16:4: He appointed some of the Levites as ministers before the ark of the LORD—to commemorate, to give thanks, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:
verses.16:5: Asaph was the head, and second to him was Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with harps and lyres, while Asaph sounded aloud with cymbals;
verses.16:6: and Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests were continually with trumpets before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.16:7: On that day David first committed the giving of thanks to the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brothers:
verses.16:8: Give thanks to the LORD, call on His name, and make His deeds known among the peoples.
verses.16:9: Sing to Him, make music to Him; speak of all His wondrous deeds.
verses.16:10: Boast in His holy name; let the heart of those seeking the LORD rejoice.
verses.16:11: Seek the LORD and His strength; seek His face continually.
verses.16:12: Remember His wondrous deeds that He has done, His marvels, and the judgments of His mouth,
verses.16:13: offspring of Israel, His servant, sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
verses.16:14: He is the LORD our God; throughout all the earth are His judgments.
verses.16:15: Remember forever His covenant, the word He commanded for a thousand generations,
verses.16:16: the one He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac;
verses.16:17: and He established it for Jacob as a statute, for Israel as an everlasting covenant,
verses.16:18: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the allotted portion of your inheritance."
verses.16:19: When you were few in number, very few and sojourning in it,
verses.16:20: they roamed from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people.
verses.16:21: He let no man oppress them, and He reproved kings for their sake:
verses.16:22: "Do not touch My anointed ones, and to My prophets do no harm."
verses.16:23: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day.
verses.16:25: For the LORD is great and exceedingly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
verses.16:26: For all the gods of the peoples are empty idols, yet the LORD made the heavens.
verses.16:27: Majesty and splendor are before Him; strength and gladness are in His place.
verses.16:28: Ascribe to the LORD, you clans of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!
verses.16:29: Ascribe to the LORD the glory of His name; bring an offering and come before Him; bow down to the LORD in holy splendor.
verses.16:30: Tremble before Him, all the earth! Surely the world is established; it will not be shaken.
verses.16:31: Let the heavens rejoice and the earth exult; let them say among the nations, "The LORD reigns!"
verses.16:32: Let the sea thunder and all its fullness; let the field be jubilant and all that is in it.
verses.16:33: Then the trees of the forest will shout for joy before the LORD, because He comes to judge the earth.
verses.16:34: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; for His loyal love endures forever.
verses.16:35: And say, "Save us, God of our salvation; gather us and rescue us from the nations, to give thanks to Your holy name and to glory in Your praise."
verses.16:36: Blessed is the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! And all the people said, "Amen," and praised the LORD.
verses.16:37: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD to minister before the ark continually, according to each day's requirement;
verses.16:38: also Obed-Edom and their brothers, sixty-eight, with Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun and Hosah as gatekeepers;
verses.16:39: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tabernacle of the LORD at the high place that was in Gibeon,
verses.16:40: to offer up burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually, morning and evening, and according to everything written in the law of the LORD, which He commanded Israel.
verses.16:41: With them were Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest of the selected ones who were designated by name to give thanks to the LORD, for His loyal love endures forever.
verses.16:42: With them—Heman and Jeduthun—were trumpets and cymbals for those sounding aloud, and instruments for the song of God; and the sons of Jeduthun were at the gate.
verses.16:43: Then all the people went away, each to his house, and David turned back to bless his household.
verses.17:1: It happened, once David was settled in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, "See, I am dwelling in a house of cedars, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD is under curtains."
verses.17:2: Nathan said to David, "Do everything that is in your heart, for God is with you."
verses.17:3: And it happened on that night that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.17:4: "Go and say to David My servant, 'This is what the LORD says: You are not the one who will build the house for Me to dwell in.
verses.17:5: For I have not dwelt in a house from the day I brought Israel up until this day, but I have been from tent to tent and from one tabernacle to another.
verses.17:6: In all the places where I walked about among all Israel, did I speak a word with any one of the judges of Israel whom I commanded to shepherd My people, saying, "Why have you not built a house of cedars for Me?"'
verses.17:7: Now then, thus you shall say to My servant David, 'This is what the LORD of hosts says: It was I who took you from the pasture, from behind the flock, to become ruler over My people Israel.
verses.17:8: And I have been with you everywhere you have gone, and I have cut off all your enemies from before you; and I will make for you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.
verses.17:9: I will appoint a place for My people Israel and plant them, so that they may dwell in their own place and be disturbed no longer; nor will the sons of wickedness wear them out anymore, as at the first,
verses.17:10: even from the days when I appointed judges over My people Israel. And I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover, I declare to you that the LORD will build a house for you.
verses.17:11: And it will happen, when your days are fulfilled to go to be with your fathers, that I will raise up your offspring after you, who will be one of your sons, and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.17:12: He is the one who will build a house for Me, and I will establish his throne forever.
verses.17:13: I will be a father to him, and he will be a son to Me; and I will not remove My loyal love from him, as I removed it from the one who was before you.
verses.17:14: And I will confirm him in My house and in My kingdom forever, and his throne will be established forever.'"
verses.17:15: In accordance with all these words and in accordance with all this vision, thus Nathan spoke to David.
verses.17:16: Then King David came in and sat before the LORD, and he said, "Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that You have brought me to this point?
verses.17:17: Yet even this was small in Your eyes, God, and You have spoken about the house of Your servant for the distant future; and You have looked upon me according to the rank of a man of high standing, LORD God.
verses.17:18: What more can David add to You for honoring Your servant? For You Yourself know Your servant.
verses.17:19: LORD, for the sake of Your servant and according to Your own heart, You have performed all this greatness, to make known all the great deeds.
verses.17:20: LORD, there is no one like You, and there is no God apart from You, in everything that we have heard with our ears.
verses.17:21: And who is like Your people Israel, the one nation on the earth whom God went to redeem for Himself as a people, to make for Yourself a name of great and awesome deeds, by driving out nations from before Your people whom You redeemed from Egypt?
verses.17:22: And You appointed Your people Israel to be a people for Yourself forever, and You, LORD, have become their God.
verses.17:23: And now, LORD, let the word that You have spoken concerning Your servant and concerning his house be confirmed forever, and do just as You have spoken.
verses.17:24: Let Your name be confirmed and become great forever, saying, 'The LORD of hosts, the God of Israel, is God to Israel,' and the house of David Your servant will be established before You.
verses.17:25: For You, my God, have uncovered the ear of Your servant that You will build a house for him; therefore Your servant has found boldness to pray before You.
verses.17:26: And now, LORD, You Yourself are God, and You have spoken this good thing concerning Your servant.
verses.17:27: And now You have been willing to bless the house of Your servant, so that it may remain before You forever; for You, LORD, have blessed it, and it is blessed forever."
verses.18:1: After this it happened that David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and he took Gath and its villages from the hand of the Philistines.
verses.18:2: And he defeated Moab, and Moab became servants to David, bearing tribute.
verses.18:3: And David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the Euphrates River.
verses.18:4: David captured from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, though he spared enough of them for one hundred chariots.
verses.18:5: When the Arameans of Damascus came to assist Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand men of Aram.
verses.18:6: Then David stationed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and Aram became servants to David, bearing tribute. And the LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.18:7: David took the shields of gold that were carried by the servants of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.18:8: And from Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took a very large quantity of bronze; with it Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the bronze articles.
verses.18:9: Now Tou king of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer king of Zobah.
verses.18:10: So he sent his son Hadoram to King David to inquire about his welfare and to bless him because he had fought against Hadadezer and defeated him—for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou—along with all kinds of articles of gold, silver, and bronze.
verses.18:11: These also King David consecrated to the LORD, together with the silver and the gold that he had carried off from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the sons of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.18:12: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt.
verses.18:13: He stationed garrisons in Edom, and all Edom became servants to David. And the LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.
verses.18:14: So David reigned over all Israel, and he continually practiced justice and righteousness for all his people.
verses.18:15: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army, and Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder.
verses.18:16: Zadok son of Ahitub and Abimelech son of Abiathar were priests, and Shavsha was the scribe.
verses.18:17: Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and the sons of David were first in rank at the side of the king.
verses.19:1: After this it happened that Nahash king of the sons of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
verses.19:2: Then David said, "I will show loyal love to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed loyal love to me." So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came into the land of the sons of Ammon, to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.19:3: But the officials of the sons of Ammon said to Hanun, "Is David honoring your father in your eyes, because he has sent comforters to you? Have his servants not come to you in order to explore, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?"
verses.19:4: So Hanun took David's servants, shaved them, cut off their garments in half up to the hips, and sent them away.
verses.19:5: And some went and told David about the men, so he sent to meet them, for the men were deeply humiliated. And the king said, "Stay at Jericho until your beards grow out, and then return."
verses.19:6: When the sons of Ammon saw that they had made themselves a stench to David, Hanun and the sons of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim, from Aram-maacah, and from Zobah.
verses.19:7: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, along with the king of Maacah and his people, who came and encamped before Medeba. Meanwhile, the sons of Ammon gathered from their cities and came for battle.
verses.19:8: When David heard of it, he sent Joab and the entire army of mighty men.
verses.19:9: The sons of Ammon marched out and drew up in battle array at the entrance of the city, while the kings who had come were by themselves in the open field.
verses.19:10: When Joab saw that the battle front was facing him both in front and behind, he selected from all the select men in Israel and drew them up in array against the Arameans.
verses.19:11: The remainder of the people he placed under the hand of his brother Abishai, and they drew up in array against the sons of Ammon.
verses.19:12: He said, "If the Arameans prove too strong for me, then you shall come to my rescue; and if the sons of Ammon prove too strong for you, then I will rescue you.
verses.19:13: Be strong, and let us prove ourselves strong on behalf of our people and on behalf of the cities of our God; and may the LORD do what is good in His eyes."
verses.19:14: So Joab and the people who were with him advanced before the Arameans for battle, and they fled from before him.
verses.19:15: When the sons of Ammon saw that the Arameans had fled, they too fled from before his brother Abishai and went into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.19:16: When the Arameans saw that they had been routed before Israel, they sent messengers and brought out the Arameans who were beyond the River, with Shophach, the commander of Hadadezer's army, at their head.
verses.19:17: When it was reported to David, he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan, came up to them, and drew up in array against them. So David drew up in battle array to meet the Arameans, and they fought against him.
verses.19:18: But the Arameans fled from before Israel, and David killed seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand foot soldiers of the Arameans; and he put Shophach, the commander of the army, to death.
verses.19:19: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they had been routed before Israel, they made peace with David and served him. So the Arameans were no longer willing to rescue the sons of Ammon.
verses.20:1: Now it happened at the turn of the year, at the time when kings go out, that Joab led the force of the army and devastated the land of the sons of Ammon; he came and besieged Rabbah, while David stayed in Jerusalem. Then Joab struck Rabbah and demolished it.
verses.20:2: David took the crown of their king off his head, and he found it to be the weight of a talent of gold, with a precious stone in it; and it was on David's head. He also brought out the spoil of the city in a very great amount.
verses.20:3: He brought out the people who were in it and cut them with the saw, with sharp iron tools, and with saws. So David did to all the cities of the sons of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.20:4: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. At that time Sibbecai the Hushathite struck down Sippai, one of the descendants of the Rephaim, and they were subdued.
verses.20:5: Again there was war with the Philistines, and Elhanan the son of Jair struck down Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite, and the shaft of his spear was like a weavers' beam.
verses.20:6: Once more there was war at Gath, and there was a man of immense stature whose fingers and toes were six and six, twenty-four in all; he too was born to Rapha.
verses.20:7: When he taunted Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David's brother, struck him down.
verses.20:8: These were born to Rapha in Gath; they fell at the hand of David and at the hand of his servants.
verses.21:1: Then Satan rose up against Israel and incited David to count Israel.
verses.21:2: So David said to Joab and to the leaders of the people, "Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan, and bring me back word so that I may know their number."
verses.21:3: Joab replied, "May the LORD add to His people a hundred times as many as they are! My lord the king, are they not all servants of my lord? Why does my lord seek this thing? Why should he become a source of guilt for Israel?"
verses.21:4: Yet the word of the king prevailed against Joab. So Joab went out and traveled throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
